root_cause.text: The tegra crypto driver omitted the `CRYPTO_ALG_ASYNC` flag from its asynchronous algorithm definitions, causing the crypto API to treat hardware-offloaded asynchronous algorithms as synchronous, leading to crashes when synchronous-only users selected them.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `CRYPTO_ALG_ASYNC` to all algorithm `cra_flags` in `tegra-se-aes.c` and `tegra-se-hash.c`, replacing or supplementing previously absent or incorrect flags (e.g., `CRYPTO_ALG_TYPE_SKCIPHER` or `CRYPTO_ALG_TYPE_AHASH`). The CVE description explicitly states: "The tegra crypto driver failed to set the CRYPTO_ALG_ASYNC on its asynchronous algorithms, causing the crypto API to select them for users that request only synchronous algorithms. This causes crashes."
